data.name: Description
data.value: Before a sensitive or critical action, Jarvis asks for your agreement: a window opens and the orb turns amber. After a spoken request he asks the question aloud; after a typed one he only says that your interaction is needed. He waits for your answer as long as it takes.

data.name: WordsHint
data.value: Your whole answer must be one of these. Anything else is a refusal. A critical action is approved with a click only.
